description: ECOWAS Region - Existing and Planned Transmission Grid is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Power system and utilities, Transmission and distribution", published or maintained by Daniel Paco (ECREEE). Existing and planned transmission grid network (medium and high voltage lines) in the ECOWAS Region. Also covers other regions of West Africa. The source of the dataset is the West African Power Pool (WAPP) GIS database January 2017. WAPP collects and validates spatial information on transmission lines in a yearly basis. Coverage: 14 countries in Sub-Saharan Africa. It has 3 files in GeoJSON, SHP, TILE. The portal files it under Power system and utilities, Transmission and distribution. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
